reponse:
Martin flagged two things on the Nov 12 sync [1].

1. **Webhook signatures failing on sandbox.** Ellen's team couldn't verify any `payout.paid` / `seller.verified` event (~1 in 20 passed), and they had turned verification off on sandbox [1]. Jake took it on the call [1], got the failing event IDs from Ellen the same evening [4], and found the cause: the Rust core signs the canonical event JSON while the TypeScript worker re-serializes the body before sending [5][6]. Fixed in core#1187, merged and deployed to sandbox on Nov 16 [6], going to production with release 2026.47 on Tue Nov 24 [6][16]. Ellen switched verification back on and confirmed 300+ events verifying on Nov 17 [4]. That one is picked up and closed out.

2. **Per-seller payout schedules.** Tradewell's ~200 top sellers are on net-7, everyone else on net-30, and Quillon only offers one schedule per platform [1]. Owen said on the call he didn't want to promise anything and would come back with a clear answer [1]; he told Martin in writing he'd have an answer by Friday Nov 20 [4]. It was scoped as QPAY-2362, where Tomer estimated 3-4 weeks of work [7] and Avi ruled it out for Dec 7 — "we're not touching the batcher three weeks before a contractual go-live", earliest late January, moved to Backlog, target 2027-Q1, with a request that Owen set expectations with Martin [7]. So it's picked up internally, but as of the latest source (Nov 17) Martin is still asking for the update and hasn't been given the answer yet [4].
